notes.title: Nebula Flow 1.0 is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
After almost a year spent in Early Access, Nebula Flow's roadmap is finally complete!
The game soundtrack will be available soon.
Thank you so much for your support over the past months. Your feedback has helped us mould Nebula Flow into a game we are proud of.


Changelog:
[list]
[*]Added support for new languages (Spanish, German, Portuguese and Italian).

[*]Soundtrack has been finalized and mastered.

[*]Added a countdown screen when resuming a level from pause, providing a short time to get ready before gameplay continues.

[*]Map creators can now choose their own preview image when uploading a new level (or editing an existing one) to the Workshop.

[*]Added additional checks to ensure integrity and authenticity of downloaded workshop levels.

[*]Custom levels that don't have a background will now, by default, use the background of the first level when played.

[*]Added gameplay input bindings to the level editor settings screen. All editor inputs are now rebindable.

[*]Fixed various UI/UX issues in both the game and the level editor.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0 release on May 13th 2025!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce that Nebula Flow will officially release its 1.0 version on May 13th 2025!

A discount will be available at launch to celebrate the end of Early Access.

Thanks to everyone who’s supported us so far!

notes.title: v0.7 Final level + new Mirage game mode!
notes.content:
This updates adds the final level of Nebula Flow, as well as a new game mode. 
Mirage is a mode that provides a new kind of challenge on levels you've already mastered.
It can be unlocked by completing every level in Standard mode, and has its own scores and leaderboards. 

Next update will add support for more languages and finally bring Nebula Flow to its full 1.0 version!


Changelog:
[list]
[*]Added final level "Hold my notes".

[*]Added new game mode "Mirage".

[*]Fixed potential crash in Training mode.

[*]Fixed Steam achievement notification not displaying at the correct time.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.6 Steam leaderboards + new features for custom levels
notes.content:
This update adds Steam leaderboards for official and custom levels. You can now compare your scores with your Steam friends, and see your global rank for any level. Leaderboards can be accessed from the level selection menu. 

You get one entry on any leaderboard per Steam account, meaning that for a given level, your leaderboard hi-score will always be the highest value found in your all your Nebula Flow profiles.
Any previous hi-score you did will be uploaded to the relevant leaderboard when first opening it. Any new hi-score will be uploaded immediately when reaching the end of a level.

Following these new features, your custom level scores are now saved into your Nebula Flow profile. You can now set a difficulty value (from 1 to 10) for your custom levels in the level editor. This value will be displayed as a number of stars (from half a star up to five stars) when you select a custom level. For leaderboard consistency, custom levels can no longer be modified aside from their metadata (title, artist, map author, difficulty, and source) once they have been uploaded to the Workshop.


Changelog:
[list]

[*]Added global/friends Steam leaderboards for official and Workshop levels.

[*]Difficulty value (stars) can now be set for custom levels in level editor.

[*]Custom levels now display best score, difficulty value and more.

[*]Some changes in level selection menus in accordance with current and upcoming features.

[*]Fixed combo counter sometimes being incremented in the wrong order by flying numbers.

[*]Fixed potential crash in level editor.

[/list]

notes.title: v0.5 New levels, scoring overhaul, and more
notes.content:
Hello!

We've added three new levels, for a current total of fourteen levels out of the fifteen planned.
We've also reworked some parts of the game in order to bring it closer to a full coherent experience.
Score is now affected by what we consider to be the three gameplay pillars of Nebula Flow: timing (as it already was), combo, and boost.

For each note hit, additional points are awarded based on timing precision, combo value (the higher, the better), and whether the boost bar is full (making it much more rewarding to not use your boost immediately). Your current best scores have been reset but previously unlocked levels will stay that way.

We've also simplified the way obstacles work by removing the sudden death phase. Obstacles now come in at a much slower rate but will immediately trigger a game over if you hit one.

If you've made a custom level: this update will probably unbalance the difficulty values (full boost/max obstacles) you previously set for your level. To that end, and to make it easier for any future custom levels you might create, we've added an "Auto-set difficulty values" option in the level editor. This will automatically match your difficulty values to something similar to the official levels by taking into account how many notes you placed and the duration of your notemap.


Changelog:
[list]

[*]Added 3 new levels following "Some more tea".

[*]Scoring entirely reworked to account for timing, combo, and boost.

[*]Reworked obstacles. Removed sudden death phase. Obstacles now immediately trigger a game over. Obstacle spawn rate and patterns updated accordingly.

[*]Many changes in GUI/feedback values displayed during gameplay (cats and flying numbers display can be toggled from the Settings/Gameplay menu).

[*]Ajusted some medal values.

[*]Performance improvements to avoid occasional stutters.

[*]Cosmetic changes in menus.

[*]Added "Auto-set difficulty values" option in custom level editor.

[*]Fixed bug where V-sync would toggle back to On when launching the game.

[*]Fixed a few minor bugs.
[/list]

We're getting closer to version 1.0! Coming soon:
[list]
[*]Steam friend leaderboards
[*]An additional end-game mode
[*]Support more languages
[/list]

Thank you for your support, have a great day!

notes.title: v0.3.0 Custom levels can now be shared on the Steam Workshop
notes.content:
Hello!
You can now share custom levels on the Steam Workshop via the level editor.
Any level you subscribe to on the workshop will appear in your custom level list.
Custom levels can now be played using any audio file from your custom level folder (Documents\My Games\Nebula Flow\custom_levels).


Changelog:

[list]
[*]Steam Workshop integration for sharing and downloading custom levels.

[*]Specific audio files can now be selected for custom levels from the game.

[*]Audio track now fades out after level is completed.

[*]A few cosmetic changes in menus.

[*]Various minor improvements/bug fixes in level editor/note generation.
[/list]

We're very excited to see what kind of levels you will share!

notes.title: v0.2.1 small patch and video tutorial for the editor

Hey! Here's a quick hotfix update following the previous v0.2.0 patch.

[list]
[*] Fixed game sometimes crashing when launching tutorial.

[/list]

Editor:
[list]

[/list]

Also, here is a video tutorial to start using Nebula Flow's level editor: [previewyoutube=wwvOYN8xVTI;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: v0.2.0 Double update! New levels, gameplay and balance changes, level editor
notes.content:
Hey there!
Due to circumstances out of our control, the previous update had to be delayed to the point where we decided to just merge it with this one instead. Our apologies for taking so long. This update hits a major milestone of Nebula Flow's early access: custom level support! 

Changelog:

[list]
[*] Refined the gameplay and balanced the difficulty accordingly.
The game is now more accessible to new players and provides a better experience overall.
The "How to play" menu and tutorial have been updated to reflect these changes.

[*] Added three new levels following "Sun-kissed".

[*] Added a level editor and custom level support. Everything is wrapped up in a fancy new "Custom levels" menu.
Full documentation is provided in the editor's help menu.

[*] Profiles can now be named.

[*] A few cosmetic and QoL changes.

[*] Fixed rare bug where a note could not be hit the next frame after hitting a move.

[*] Some performance improvements.

[*] Fixed a few minor bugs.
[/list]

For the next major update, we will focus on achievements and Steam workshop integration for custom levels.
Thank you for supporting us, we hope you'll enjoy what we've been cooking up.

notes.title: Nebula Flow is now in Early Access !
notes.content:
Greetings everyone ! We are very excited to announce that Nebula Flow is now available in Early Access.
Go get your copy at a 10% discount until the 2nd of July [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2616170?utm_source=steam&utm_content=announcement&utm_campaign=ea_release]on the Store Page ![/url] 

[previewyoutube=3Bjn7ANob-k;full][/previewyoutube]

This release marks an important milestone for us, and we're eager to continue the journey to 1.0 with our community. Your support, feedback and suggestions will be invaluable to us. For this purpose, you can either use the in-game tool, or post in the Steam Discussions. 

[h1]What's in Early Access ?[/h1]

Since the playtest phase that we had in April we've added added more levels, which brings the total to 8. While the first 6 levels have the intended difficulty curve, the last 2 are meant to be among the hardest ones.
We plan to add [b]7 more levels[/b] to fill this gap, over the course of the Early Access period.

We will be also adding [b]achievements, friends leaderboards, support for more languages, and a level editor ![/b]

If you want to get a taste of the game, the demo will continue to be available. It features the first 3 levels.

We hope that you have fun with Nebula Flow !

Thanks for your support,
Nico & Songe
